notes: family: end-game-categories. Game end: when the Black deck empties, finish the round plus one final round (max 1 Black puzzle per turn after trigger). Then Finishing Touches (all done before any puzzle counts as completed, no bonus pieces). Each puzzle's printed value is read from the card. Solo mode and Finesse/Ghost Piece/line-clear variants not modelled.
